content.text: {"core": "Reciprocity gives back what it takes, matching one exchange to the next so nothing piles up owed. At Source, where things first arrive, it meets each new thing with an answering return — the incoming is received and something goes back in kind. In proportion, arrival and return stay linked, and what enters never stalls into a debt that clogs the opening.", "sheetLine": "What comes in gets an answer back; the doorway stays clear."}
